issue_context.title: [feat] More flexibility in HTTP requests used by Updater
issue_context.body:
### Describe the problem

We need to be able to construct different headers for the HTTP request used to check for available updates, and the HTTP  request used to download the update. 

For example, if you set AWS SIGv4 headers on the request to check for updates, the same headers are not appropriate to attempt to download the update from AWS S3 (in fact the S3 request is impossible) - but I can find no way to modify the headers between checking and downloading.  

Sending signed requests, using user provided credentials for example,  would also be significantly easier if the updater endpoints could be modified after application start (different from the solution suggested https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/2595#issuecomment-1160772317) 

### Describe the solution you'd like

Minimally, setters on `UpdateResponse` that allowed the headers to be changed. 
Ideally, also setters on `UpdateBuilder` that allowed the endpoints to be changed dynamically.
